Name: Sunrise Transitions - Customizable Morning Lighting Effects
Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
[center][b][size=6]Sunrise Transitions
[/size][/b]
[i]Wake up to the beauty of a real sunrise with a fully customizable, seasonal morning overhaul.
[/i][/center][center][color=#00ff00]Thanks SuperSaiyanLissy for the idea![/color][/center][center]﻿[/center][center]Safe to install/uninstall
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements][/url][/center][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements][center]﻿[/center][center]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements[/center][/url][center][/center]Works perfectly alongside [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41133]Golden Transitions[/url][/b] (which handles sunset) and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40783]Dynamic Dusk[/url] (which handles day length).


[line]

[size=4][b]The Concept
[/b][/size]
In vanilla Stardew Valley, you wake up at 6:00 AM to a screen that is already fully bright. You miss the serene, misty atmosphere of the early morning.

[b]Sunrise Transitions[/b] changes that.

When you wake up, the world is bathed in a stunning atmospheric glow that slowly fades away as the morning progresses. Whether it's the cold blue mist of Winter or the warm golden rays of Summer, this mod brings the start of your day to life.


[b][color=#ffff00]Graph[/color][/b]:

Peak intensity when you wake up 6AM

Slowly fade away by 9 AM.

All configurable, intensity, color, and fading period 

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41189/41189-1768190867-94653929.png[/img]


[line]

[size=4][b]Key Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*] [b]Aesthetic Seasonal Presets (Included)[/b]
The mod comes pre-configured with professional aesthetic profiles designed to match the mood of every season:[list]
[*] [color=#ffff00][b]Spring:[/b] "Soft Peach" Dawn (Pastel Pink/Orange). A cozy, romantic start to the day[/color].
[*] [color=#00ffff][b]Summer & Fall:[/b] "Golden Hour" Morning (Bright, Realistic Sunrays). Energetic and warm.[/color]
[*] [color=#ff7700][b]Winter:[/b] "Blue Hour" Mist (Cinematic Cyan/White). A crisp, cold, and fresh morning atmosphere.[/color]
[/list][/list][list]
[*] [b]Full Customization[/b]
Don't like the defaults? You have full [b]RGB control[/b]. You can tweak the color, intensity, and duration for every season individually using the config menu.[*][b]Dynamic Randomization[/b]
Want every morning to feel unique? Enable [b]Random Mode[/b]. The mod will randomly pick one of your seasonal presets based on your chosen frequency (Daily, Weekly, or Seasonally).* [i]Example:[/i] Wake up to a rare, foggy "Winter-style" morning in the middle of Summer.[*] [b]Smooth Fading[/b]
The effect starts at peak intensity when you wake up (6:00 AM) and slowly dissolves into the standard daylight over a duration you control (default is 3-4 hours).[/list]
[center][youtube]zw0Aq7Hpc80[/youtube][youtube]8qpdig4kD8E[/youtube][youtube]lNRLgvpq77Y[/youtube][/center]






[line]

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
You can tweak every aspect of the morning using [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b].

[b]1. Seasonal Profiles[/b]
The menu has separate sections for Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter.
[list]
[*] [b]RGB Color:[/b] The exact color of the morning light.
[*] [b]Start Intensity:[/b] How strong the glow is at 6:00 AM (Opacity 0-100%).
[*] [b]Duration:[/b] How many minutes it takes for the glow to completely disappear (e.g., set to 180 mins to have clear skies by 9:00 AM).
[/list]

[b]2. Create Your Own[/b]
Want to make your own atmosphere? Here are the recipes for the default styles if you want to mix and match:

[list]
[*] [b]Soft Peach (Spring Vibe)[/b]
[i]R: 255 | G: 218 | B: 185[/i][*] [b]Golden Hour (Summer Vibe)[/b]
[i]R: 255 | G: 204 | B: 51[/i][*] [b]Blue Hour Mist (Winter Vibe)[/b]
[i]R: 224 | G: 247 | B: 250[/i][/list][center]﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41189/41189-1768190879-1852037180.png[/img]﻿[/center][center]﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41189/41189-1768190879-621985845.png[/img]﻿[/center]

[line]

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*] Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
[*] Download [b]Sunrise Transitions[/b].
[*] Unzip the folder into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.
[*] Run the game.
[/list]

[i]Optional:[/i] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to edit colors and timing in real-time.

[line]

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+
[*] Works perfectly alongside [b]Golden Transitions[/b] (which handles sunset) and [b]Dynamic Dusk[/b] (which handles day length).
[*] Compatible with most texture replacements and recolors (overlay renders on top of the world).
[/list]
